title: Logarithmic-space membership
statement: The language of Boolean words of the form $\langle 1^n,\operatorname{bits}(2n)\rangle$, with $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and the pairing formed by doubling each bit of the first word, appending the separator $01$, and then the second word, belongs to logarithmic space. Here logarithmic space means that some finite-state multi-tape Turing machine decides membership while using at most a constant multiple of $\lfloor\log_2 N\rfloor+1$ work-tape cells on inputs of length $N$.
